name: A Thread of Silver
body:
Source Dungeoneer's Handbook pg. 15
Price 6,700 gp; Accuracy +7
Category Dungeon Guides
Associated Skill Knowledge (engineering) (DC 25)
Description
This thick leather-bound book was stolen from the Technic League by unknown hands, and describes one of the earliest surveys of the Silver Mount of Numeria and nearby ruins. The League’s assassins brutally hunt down anyone with a copy.
Skill Bonuses
Disable clockwork trap (Disable Device +2)
Evaluate Numerian relic (Appraise +4)
Identify construct creature (Knowledge [arcana] +4)
